answer.rationale: Provisionally renew the incumbent because the 14-day expiry, 94% line loading, and lack of buffer make an immediate primary-vendor migration a material delivery risk. Verify the incumbent’s demonstrated continuity and the low-cost vendor’s prior onboarding performance before committing; the latter may change the decision if the archive shows equivalent delivery assurance within the deadline. Renewal conflicts with the 18% spend mandate, but avoiding interruption currently dominates uncertain unit-price savings in total cost of ownership.
